item.title: Where to find the Daikoku area in Forza Horizon 6
item.description: In Forza Horizon 6 , you can visit Daikoku , a famous area for those who enjoy Japanese automotive culture. It's located in the Tokyo City region and, in real life, it's well-known for hosting car meets — just like the in-game ones you can take part in if you stop by the Daikoku Parking Area.

item.title: Star Wars 50th Anniversary Release Will Include New Music from John Williams
item.description: Star Wars is celebrating its 50th anniversary in 2027. The original cut of the first film (later subtitled Episode IV – A New Hope ) will hit theaters in February , and it will be accompanied by brief new music from longtime Star Wars composer John Williams.

item.title: All battle pass skins in the Fortnite Chapter 7 mini season
item.description: Fortnite 's Chapter 7 mini season , "Treasure Hunters," has kicked off, bringing a smaller battle pass alongside it (as one would expect from a shorter season). This battle pass is full of goodies, including two outfits featuring characters from One Piece and some anime-styled Fortnite characters.

item.title: Witcher Multiplayer Game Adds Key Writer From Baldur’s Gate 3
item.description: CD Projekt Red has a lot of irons in the proverbial fire right now, one being a Witcher multiplayer game codenamed Project Sirius . While it was first revealed back in 2022 alongside other projects that would later be confirmed as The Witcher 4 and a remake of the original Witcher , Sirius has had a troubled development thus far. CD Projekt Red continues to add talent to the project, however, with the latest addition being one of the writers behind some of Baldur's Gate 3 's best storylines.

item.title: GTA 6 Map Seemingly Leaks at Merch Drop Event
item.description: With Grand Theft Auto 6 , Rockstar Games has already experienced some of the highest-profile leaks in gaming history, and it seems at least one more has snuck in before the game’s impending Nov. 19 release . Pictures are circulating of what appears to be a physical poster of GTA 6 ’s map .

item.title: GTA 6 Nearly Hit With Ban Over ‘Frequent Male Genital Exposure’
item.description: With the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6 mere days away, we already know to expect a whole lot of mature subject matter. Official promotional materials like the Netflix Extended Look have prominently featured strip clubs, drug deals gone wrong, and chaotic vehicular shootouts. A new report out of South Korea from Inven Global claims members of the Game Content Rating Board (GCRB) nearly refused to issue a rating for GTA 6 , which would have effectively banned the game there. The main sticking point? An excessive amount of "out of context genital nudity."

item.title: Are there too many tentacles in Resident Evil?
item.description: The VFX wizards at Weta Workshop had their hands full (of tentacles) working on Zach Cregger's Resident Evil.

item.title: Walmart's Black Friday Deals Offer A 'Pokémon' 30th Anniversary TCG Surprise
item.description: Black Friday is coming early for Walmart shoppers who like to play or collect the Pokémon Trading Card Game. The retailer is stocking a few TCG products beginning on Thursday, Nov. 12, including the hard-to-find Pokémon 30th Anniversary set.

item.title: Why is everyone obsessed with World of Warcraft again? | Point It Out!
item.description: Patches and Simone bring games reporter and WoW fanatic Oli Welsh back on the show to discuss the launch of World of Warcraft Forever, Blizzard's new installment to the WoW ecosystem. But what's so compelling about playing an old MMO, and why have millions of people gone back to it? Oli has the answers, including in an interview with Blizzard devs Ion Hazzikostas and Clay Stone. All that and more on Point It Out!

item.title: Deadpool and Wolverine Stars Get Surprise Credit on Avengers: Doomsday
item.description: Doctor Doom arrives in a little over a month, and at this point it feels like we have a good grasp of the main players in Avengers: Doomsday . Disney just posted a rundown of the characters central to the story , with the obvious ones being the original MCU Avengers Steve Rogers, and Thor. Beyond that, the film will also center on Sam Wilson (the new Captain America), Ant-Man, and Shang-Chi. The Fantastic Four will have a prominent role as well, which makes sense considering Victor von Doom originates from that supergroup’s comics. The New Avengers from Thunderbolts will appear alongside Wakandans like Shuri.
